overloadPatches.note: tool4d-lsp-stdio rejects 'PRINT RECORD([T];*;>)' -- confirmed by live cross-check that '*' and '>' are mutually exclusive alternatives (two distinct doc syntax lines, 'PRINT RECORD(aTable{;*})' vs 'PRINT RECORD(aTable{;>})'), not two independently-combinable flags on one overload. A prior overlay revision incorrectly merged them into a single 3-param overload; reverted to keeping the two doc syntax lines as separate overloads, only correcting aTable's optionality (the parameter table documents it as defaulting to the default table when omitted, despite the doc syntax line omitting braces around it).

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to print the current record, or the default table if omitted.
Suppress the printing dialog box, using the current print parameters.

overloadPatches.note: Second doc syntax line ('...{;>}'); autoparse dropped the '>' param here because its name ('>') doesn't match the parser's identifier pattern. Restored it explicitly.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to print the current record, or the default table if omitted.
Do not reinitialize the current print parameters (useful across successive calls, e.g. inside a loop).

constraints: Does nothing if there is no current record for aTable.
Prints unsaved modifications to the record (in-memory values), not the values on disk.
Unlike Print form, this command can print subforms.
If the user cancels the Print job dialog box (when not suppressed), the command is canceled and the record is not printed.
